_comment: ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every tunable threshold in the product.
Read by the Python pipeline, the Go API and the frontend build. Nothing
may redeclare a value that lives here: a constant copied into two
languages is a rule with two places to get it wrong, and this project has
already shipped the same rule twice with different behaviour.
The Go API REFUSES TO START if a value it needs is missing, rather than
falling back to a default that might not match what the pipeline used.
That is the pattern the artifact detector already follows via the history
Every value carries the finding that produced it. Change one and the
reason has to change with it.

resolutions._why: res-9 (~0.105 km2) is fine enough that a 500 m k-ring approximates a circle; res-8 (~0.74 km2) is the coverage grid and Kontur's native resolution.

catchment._why: Cells are ~0.105 km2, so a continuous radius moves nothing then jumps 7 cells to 19. k=0 is one cell, and at that size a shop 30 m past the boundary vanishes while cross-source position error is 58 m at p90 - two nearby pins would disagree for reasons that are resolution, not geography.

land_fraction_floor._why: Dividing by habitable land is right, but as the land share approaches zero the quotient stops describing geography: an Alexandria Corniche cell 99.99% sea produced 8,260,594 people/km2. land_fraction exceeds 0.95 for 95% of res-9 cells and only 0.34% fall below 0.05, so this discards almost nothing.

saturation._why: GHSL built-up share of cell area. A SATURATED catchment reads flat on construction because it is built out - that means no new building, never no commercial change.

corroboration._why: Corroboration requires COUNT AGREEMENT, not co-existence. 0.5 was rejected as circular - it was the observed median disagreement, so setting the bar there would call the typical case agreement.

percentages._why: A percentage needs a base big enough to carry one. 3 to 1 is '-66.7%', which dresses a difference of two records as a finding.

inhabited._why: The operational polygon is four governorates plus a 2 km dilation ring, so it contains desert and Delta farmland whose cells lack business data because they lack businesses. Both conditions are required: population alone admits farmland, built-up alone admits airports and industrial land.

duplicates._why: Deliberately conservative: the fuzzy matcher scored 100% in-sample and 25% out-of-sample, so only cross-source pairs close in space AND similar in name are flagged, and nothing is ever merged.

series._why: A 3-point line renders as a trend and is not one. Better to withhold a corrected series with a stated reason than to plot something too short to read honestly.
